info.name: Emergency Ambulance Dispatch System API
info.description:
# Emergency Ambulance Dispatch System

Complete API collection for the Emergency Ambulance Dispatch System backend.

## Base URLs
- **Local**: `http://localhost:5000`
- **Production**: `https://ambulance-dispatch-backend-66f2.onrender.com`

## Authentication
This collection uses Bearer Token authentication. Tokens are automatically managed by test scripts after login or register. The collection-level pre-request script auto-refreshes expired access tokens.

## Roles
| Role | Description |
|---|---|
| `PATIENT` | Default public role. Can create emergency requests and pay. |
| `DRIVER` | Assigned by Admin. Can view dispatches and update trip status. |
| `ADMIN` | Full system access including user, ambulance, and driver management. |

## Workflow Order
1. Login as Admin
2. Create Ambulance
3. Create Driver (Admin Direct Onboarding)
4. Register / Login as Patient
5. Create Emergency Request
6. Admin Dispatches Ambulance + Driver
7. Driver updates trip status
8. Patient pays via gateway
9. Verify payment and check admin stats

item.name: 09. Payment Module
item.description:
Multi-gateway payment processing: Stripe, bKash Tokenized PGW, and SSLCommerz.

**Payment Rules**:
- Payment is only allowed when request status is `DISPATCHED` or `COMPLETED`.
- Duplicate payments on a successful request return `409 Conflict`.
- On payment success, request status transitions to `COMPLETED`.

Returns the payment record for a given emergency request. Status: `PENDING`, `SUCCESS`, `FAILED`, `REFUNDED`.
Expected: `400 Bad Request` — payment is only allowed for DISPATCHED or COMPLETED requests. Run this **before** dispatching to verify the guard.
